name: Bistro Stazione
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bistro Stazione in Tirol** Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps. Our cozy bistro in **Innsbruck** offers a warm atmosphere where traditional flavors meet modern twists. Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast or savor freshly baked **Strudel** with vanilla sauce. For lunch, enjoy hearty pasta dishes like **Tagliatelle al Ragù** or a crisp **Caprese Salad** with local **Tiroler Bergkäse**. In the evening, unwind with a glass of fine Italian wine and share a plate of **Tiramisu** or **Cannoli**. Our menu changes seasonally, featuring fresh, local ingredients—from **Tiroler Speck** to wild mushrooms foraged in the surrounding mountains. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**’s historic old town or taking a break after a day of hiking in the **Karwendel** or **Nordkette**, Bistro Stazione is your perfect stop for a taste of Italy in the Alps. **Come visit us at:**
